# Fobign Technologies API Documentation
> Unified AI Gateway & Multi-Model Inference Proxy

- Documentation Home: https://docs.fobign.com
- API Endpoint: https://api.fobign.com/v1
- Developer Console: https://platform.fobign.com
- Contact & Support: hello@fobign.com

## Core API Endpoints

### 1. Chat Completions
- URL: POST https://api.fobign.com/v1/chat/completions
- Spec: OpenAI compatible JSON payload with server-sent events (`stream: true`).
- Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <FOBIGN_API_KEY>`, `Content-Type: application/json`
- Supports: DeepSeek, OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Mistral, Llama 3 models.

### 2. Anthropic Messages
- URL: POST https://api.fobign.com/v1/messages
- Spec: Anthropic Claude compatible payload with `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`.
- Headers: `x-api-key: <FOBIGN_API_KEY>`, `Content-Type: application/json`

### 3. Model Discovery
- URL: GET https://api.fobign.com/v1/models
- Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <FOBIGN_API_KEY>`
- Returns: Active models, context windows, and token pricing rates.

### 4. Vector Embeddings
- URL: POST https://api.fobign.com/v1/embeddings
- Input: String or list of tokens
- Compatible with text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-3-large, bge-m3.
